story: Portland outlasted Victor Wembanyama's 44 points and handed San Antonio its first road loss of the season, 116–111.
aria: Animated Short: Deni Avdija's 26-foot bank-shot 3-pointer off Damian Lillard's pass with 38 seconds left that made it 114–109 on the way to a 116–111 Trail Blazers win over San Antonio. An original illustration, not traced from footage, not to scale.
